caption: The drawing depicts two small, similarly shaped ceramic jugs positioned side by side against a beige background. Each jug is rendered in shades of light gray and brown, with darker accents and decorative blue designs on their fronts. The jug on the left features a heart-shaped motif incorporating a stylized tulip or floral element, with the letters "T S" positioned beneath the design. The jug on the right displays a more elaborate, open flower with leaves, and the letters "T C" underneath. Both jugs have short, narrow necks with visibly chipped or damaged rims. The surface of the jugs shows some mottling and irregularities in color, suggesting texture or aging. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the artist's name, "John Tarantino," is inscribed in small capital letters.
title: Miniature Flask
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
